render.description: mail.RenderOTPEmail + smtp.go buildMessage. minutes = max(1, floor((expires_at - now_at_render) / 1 minute)) using the wall clock at render time. The identity service sets expires_at = now + OTP_CHALLENGE_TTL and renders a moment later, so the default 10m TTL always shows "9 minute(s)" (case ttl_10m_rendered_after_issue). App name and code are HTML-escaped in the HTML body only (& < > " -> & < > "; ' is not escaped); subject and text are raw. The Subject header is NOT RFC 2047 encoded (raw UTF-8). MIME: CRLF header lines, fixed boundary, text part then HTML part, bodies inserted verbatim (text keeps LF line endings), each part followed by CRLF.
